taxon.wikipedia_summary: Eucalyptus bicostata, commonly known as Victorian blue gum, Southern blue gum or Eurabbie, is a eucalypt species native to Victoria and eastern New South Wales, Australia. It grows in wet forests on fertile soils in sheltered areas in ranges away from the coast. Many botanists consider Eucalyptus bicostata to be a subspecies of Eucalyptus globulus.
